note: Case manifest for the Morgan naturalness suite. Audio lives in clips/ and reference/ (gitignored, voice data); this manifest carries no audio and no transcript text. source is 'morgan' for session recordings and 'reference_avm' for AVM references (the metrics CLI stamps it into each case's JSON and the report splits its tables on it); lever_state names the prompt/config state a Morgan recording was made under; held_out marks the AVM recording excluded from tuning discussions.
